name: Lifeguard training and hiring
org: Austin Parks and Recreation Department, Aquatic Division
what_you_do: You train as a certified lifeguard. You work at City of Austin pools and aquatic facilities. New and returning guards fill out an application. They also do hiring paperwork before they sign up for training.
who_can_apply: Lifeguard training and hiring starts at age 15 with no upper age limit. You need a physical Social Security card and Texas-issued ID for the in-person paperwork.
duration: Seasonal; training happens before the swim season
deadline_text: The city says it is now hiring for spring and summer 2027, as of Nov 4, 2026. No closing date is posted. Be ready to work by Memorial Day.
how_to_apply: Step 1: fill out the online lifeguard job application. Use the Lifeguard I posting. Step 2: visit the Aquatic Office in person at 2818 San Gabriel St. with your Social Security card, Texas ID and any hiring paperwork emailed to you. Questions: 512-974-9330.
notes: The 2026 posting also offered a $200 stipend for guards trained and working 40 hours before July 4, 2026. One library list says age 16+; the Parks page (dated March 20, 2026) says 15. Texas hour limits apply to 15 year olds.
